selection: Shortest attack distance among physically acceptable cofolds passing angle >=150 degrees and distance <=4.5 A; all 50 cofolds inspected per enzyme; no activity labels used.
primary: Mean native-contact retention at 10 ns, two independent endpoints per selected starting pose, only qualifying starts and geometry-eligible endpoints.
inference: 192 independent endpoints, 48 enzymes, two seeds at each of 1 and 10 ns; no contact conditioning.
statistics: Enzyme-level Spearman association and fixed-alpha LOO ridge incremental prediction; exploratory retrospective panel.
